review_candidates.title: Venture Capital Careers
review_candidates.description: 📍 London Vienna Bombay Singapore Tokyo New York Full-time Who We Are Private markets are at an inflection point. AI. Generational wealth transfer. Geopolitical fragmentation. Everything is shifting, and the managers who will define what comes next are still invisible to the capital that should be backing them. That is the problem Allocator One was built to solve. Four years in, we have built thousands of manager relationships across VC, PE, and private credit, backed the top 3% through two vintages, and generated 10 unicorns in the portfolio. We are nowhere near done. Alongside backing managers, we built Infra One: an AI-native fund operating platform that enables GPs to fundraise seamlessly across global markets, focus on value creation, and give their LPs real-time data and intelligence. The data compounds with every fund we touch. The pattern recognition gets sharper every vintage. The edge widens every quarter. We back the specialist emerging managers the rest of the market hasn't found yet: the ones too early, too focused, and too unconventional for consensus capital to touch. We find them before the data is obvious and back them before the narrative is written. This is what building a generational firm feels like from the inside. Tasks The role You will work directly with our founding partner and the broader IR team, sitting at the centre of a fundraising operation scaling fast to meet the demands of the world's most sophisticated allocators. You know how to hold a room and close a conversation. You are equally at ease building a fund model as you are crafting the narrative that makes an LP lean forward. You don't hand things off. You own them end to end, from the first investor touchpoint to the signed commitment. What sets you apart is how you operate. AI is baked into your workflow, automating the grind so the team stays focused on high-value conversations, not admin. Materials are tighter, follow-up is faster, and the fundraising pipeline runs with the kind of discipline most GPs spend years trying to install. What You'll Own AI-powered workflow automation Systematically identify and eliminate repetitive manual tasks across the IR function: drafting, reporting, CRM updates, follow-up sequences, scheduling Build and deploy AI agent workflows that run in the background of the fundraising operation, not as one-off experiments Infra One, our AI-native operating platform, is already deeply embedded in how we work. You will bridge it with IR team operations and push it further Make the team measurably faster every month. If a task is done more than twice, it should be automated Fund modeling & analytics Build and maintain fund models across VC, PE/buyout, and private credit to support investor conversations, product structuring, and fund launch decisions Use AI to sharpen modeling workflows: scenario generation, sensitivity analysis, and automated validation against live platform data Translate financial outputs into clean, investor-ready narratives the IR team can use without needing a translator Investor relations & communications Own and produce all investor-facing materials: pitch decks, fund updates, LP memos, one-pagers, data room content, blurbs, and mandate specs, all with a consistent institutional-grade voice Manage investor communications across every channel: email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, event follow-up. You are the voice of the IR function when it matters most Structure, maintain, and govern data rooms across active fundraises, accurate, current, and access-controlled at all times Create and maintain a library of reusable IR content including messaging frameworks, objection handlers, and FAQs that the whole team can deploy at spee Requirements What we're looking for Financially fluent. You understand fund economics: management fees, carry, waterfalls, IRR, LP return profiles. You can build a VC or PE model from scratch and explain it clearly in conversation Genuine passion for private markets. A space you understand deeply, see the gaps and inefficiencies, you want to reshape it rather than inheriting the old playbook AI-native. You have built workflows with LLMs and agents, not just used them. You think about automation the way a good operator thinks about hiring: the first question is always whether a system can do it better Outstanding communicator. You write with precision, adapt your tone to the audience, and are compelling in a room. From a cold LP email to a presentation in front of a sovereign wealth fund, you own it End-to-end ownership mentality. You don't pass things off. You track, follow up, and close. The details are the reputation and nothing falls through the cracks on your watch Proactive by default. You see a gap, a bottleneck, an inefficiency, and you fix it before anyone asks Nice to have: CRM platform experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar), familiarity with data room tools, knowledge of tokenization or digital assets in a private markets context Languages: English fluency required Benefits What you’ll get €80,000+ /year + performance bonus depending on level of experience Performance bonus tied to jointly defined OKRs, because sharp work deserves sharp recognition A high-standards, low-ego culture. We challenge each other's thinking, not each other's character Offices in London, Vienna, Bombay, Singapore, Tokyo, New York, with remote flexibility built in Direct access to the full architecture of a fast-scaling private markets platform and a front row seat to how the world's best emerging managers get built and backed Global events worth attending: the kind where you actually meet the people shaping the next decade of private markets Real ownership. If you're exceptional, the role grows with you Why this role exists We are building a generational firm to invest in the best emerging fund managers at scale. Allocator One exists to give allocators trusted access to specialist investors, real market intelligence, and the tools to actively participate. In a fragmented, AI-accelerating world, selection and transparency decide outcomes, we know the gaps on both sides of the table. So we built the selection engine, the trust network, and the infrastructure to close them. Not to participate in private markets. To shape how they work. This role sits at the heart of that mission. If this is your lane, we want to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Trade Compliance Manager
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are hiring a Trade Compliance Manager on behalf of our client for a fully remote position based in the Czech Republic . The role is responsible for ensuring that import and export activities across the European region comply with applicable trade regulations. You will work closely with global operations, internal trade compliance teams, and customers to provide practical guidance on complex international trade requirements. This is a highly specialized position supporting a U.S.-based organization serving high-tech manufacturers , so strong expertise in U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), EU dual-use controls, and high-tech service logistics is essential. Key Responsibilities Manage Harmonized Tariff classifications and Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCNs) across multiple companies and countries. Support the development, maintenance, and adjustment of trade compliance rules within Trade Compliance Management systems. Review and manage product information, including classifications, data sheets, test reports, certifications, and import/export licenses. Provide procedural guidance to global operations teams and assist with resolving import and export compliance issues. Collaborate with internal departments to monitor compliance with local regulations and record-retention requirements. Conduct audits of import and export clearance documentation. Identify potential compliance issues, risks, and red flags. Develop practical solutions to reduce compliance risks while supporting business objectives. Lead consultative conversations with customers and provide education and guidance on trade compliance matters. Support compliance requirements relating to repairs, returns, RMAs, service spare parts, technical data, and software moving across international borders. Key Areas of Expertise The successful candidate should have significant experience with: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) , including: Export, re-export, and transfer rules ECCN classification Export authorizations De minimis rules Foreign Direct Product (FDP) rules End-use and end-user controls EU Dual-Use Regulation and applicable national laws. Technology, software, and encryption controls. Global customs practices and trade restrictions. FCPA and anti-boycott requirements. Incoterms 2020. Trade Compliance Management Systems. Corporate Work Instructions and compliance procedures. Industry & Product Experience Experience in a high-tech or service logistics environment is required, particularly involving: Repairs and returns/RMAs Service spare parts International logistics High-tech products Semiconductors Advanced computing Telecommunications Networking infrastructure Experience with data protection is an advantage. Customer & Regional Scope Provide trade compliance guidance to customers across multiple EMEA countries . Support operations across different jurisdictions and regulatory environments. Communicate complex compliance requirements clearly to both internal teams and external customers. Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Requirements 5+ years of trade compliance experience . Extensive knowledge of U.S. EAR and EU dual-use controls. Experience with ECCN classification and export authorization requirements. Experience with de minimis and FDP rules. Experience with end-use and end-user controls. Significant experience in high-tech products and/or service logistics involving repairs, RMAs, and spare parts. Experience supporting trade compliance across multiple EMEA countries. Experience developing Corporate Work Instructions. Experience using Trade Compliance Management Systems. Knowledge of global customs, trade restrictions, FCPA, anti-boycott legislation, and Incoterms 2020. Excellent English communication skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage complex and competing priorities. Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience. Working Arrangement Location: Czech Republic Work mode: Fully remote Employment: Full-time, permanent Travel: Up to 10% to company facilities and customer sites may be required. The successful candidate will work remotely from their residence in the Czech Republic. Compensation €50,000–€100,000 annually , depending on experience and qualifications.

review_candidates.description: About The Role We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven President to lead the overall business performance, strategic growth, and operational execution of a diversified Construction & Real Estate organization. The President will provide executive leadership across construction, real estate development, property investment, business development, project delivery, financial performance, and organizational growth. This individual will be responsible for translating the Board's strategic vision into measurable business results, driving revenue and profitability, expanding the company's development pipeline, and ensuring operational excellence across the organization. The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with extensive experience in construction, real estate development, property investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, and a demonstrated track record of managing large-scale operations and P&L responsibilities. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Leadership & Strategy Lead the company's overall business operations and execution of its strategic objectives. Translate the Board's vision into clear annual and long-term business plans. Identify opportunities for expansion, diversification, acquisitions, partnerships, and new markets. Establish organizational KPIs and ensure accountability across the leadership team. Provide regular performance updates, strategic recommendations, and forecasts to the Board. 2. P&L & Commercial Performance Assume overall responsibility for revenue, profitability, cash flow, and P&L performance. Drive sustainable growth while maintaining strong financial discipline. Oversee annual budgets, forecasts, capital expenditure, and resource allocation. Improve operating margins, project profitability, working capital, and return on investment. Work closely with Finance and senior leadership on capital allocation and investment decisions. 3. Construction Operations Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major projects. Ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within approved budgets. Strengthen project governance, cost management, procurement, contracting, and risk controls. Monitor the performance of contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project partners. Ensure compliance with construction, environmental, health & safety, and quality requirements. 4. Real Estate Development Lead the company's real estate development strategy and development pipeline. Oversee land acquisition, feasibility, financing, planning, approvals, development, construction, sales, leasing, and asset disposition. Evaluate new development opportunities and investment proposals. Maximize the commercial value of the company's property portfolio. Develop relationships with investors, developers, landowners, financial institutions, brokers, and strategic partners. 5. Business Development Drive new business generation and expansion of the company's market presence. Develop relationships with major corporate, institutional, government, and private-sector clients. Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, strategic partnerships, and development agreements. Identify new revenue streams and opportunities for business diversification. Strengthen the company's competitive position and market reputation. 6. Investment & Capital Allocation Evaluate major property acquisitions, development projects, investments, and strategic opportunities. Ensure investment decisions are aligned with risk appetite and expected returns. Work with financial institutions, investors, and partners to secure appropriate financing. Monitor the performance and value creation of major investments and assets. 7. Governance & Risk Management Ensure strong governance and accountability across business units, projects, subsidiaries, and joint ventures. Establish effective enterprise and project risk-management frameworks. Oversee legal, regulatory, contractual, financial, and operational risks. Maintain appropriate internal controls and compliance standards. 8. Leadership & Talent Lead and develop a high-performing executive leadership team. Establish a culture of accountability, performance, innovation, safety, and operational excellence. Strengthen organizational capabilities to support future growth. Develop succession plans for key leadership positions. Ensure effective collaboration between construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions. 9. Stakeholder & Government Relations Serve as a senior representative of the company with government authorities, investors, lenders, clients, partners, regulators, and industry stakeholders. Build and maintain strategic relationships with key government and regulatory institutions. Represent the organization at major industry, investment, and business forums. Key Performance Indicators The President will be accountable for: Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth Overall P&L performance Construction project delivery and profitability Real estate development pipeline Portfolio and asset-value growth Return on invested capital Cash flow and working capital New business and strategic partnerships Market expansion Project safety and quality Operational efficiency Leadership-team performance and organizational capability Candidate Profile Must-Have Experience 15+ years of senior leadership experience in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector. Previous experience as President, CEO, Managing Director, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent. Proven experience managing a significant P&L and large multidisciplinary organization. Strong track record in construction operations and/or real estate development. Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, profitability, operational improvement, and business expansion. Strong commercial, financial, investment, and project-management capabilities. Experience managing large-scale projects, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and strategic partners. Strong experience dealing with Boards, investors, banks, government authorities, and major clients. Preferred Experience Experience leading a diversified construction and real estate group. Exposure to residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or large-scale urban-development projects. Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, acquisitions, institutional investment, or private equity. Experience managing businesses through significant growth, transformation, restructuring, or expansion. International or multi-country experience is an advantage. Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. MBA or relevant Master's degree preferred. Relevant Professional Qualifications Are An Advantage. Core Competencies Executive Leadership Strategic Planning & Execution P&L Management Construction Operations Real Estate Development Investment & Capital Allocation Business Development Commercial Negotiation Project Governance Risk Management Corporate Governance Government & Stakeholder Relations Organizational Transformation Team Leadership Financial & Commercial Acumen Leadership Profile The successful candidate will be: Strategic, commercially minded, and highly execution-oriented Comfortable managing large and complex businesses Strong in financial and investment decision-making An exceptional negotiator and relationship builder Experienced in high-value construction and property transactions Capable of working effectively with a Board and Chairman Decisive, accountable, and results-oriented Able to build and lead a strong executive management team
